items.description: Tenant's aggregate liability to Landlord for breaches of the Lease and matters relating to its occupancy is capped, with stated exceptions for rent, hazardous materials and third-party injury or property damage claims.
items.span_text: shall be limited, in the aggregate, solely to an amount equal to Five Million ($5,000,000.00) Dollars

items.anchor_event: written notice to Landlord of such failure
items.description: Landlord must cure a failure to perform its Lease Undertakings within a cure period after written notice, extended if cure is commenced and diligently pursued, or a Landlord Default occurs.
items.span_text: (b) such failure continues for a period of twenty (20) days following written notice to Landlord of such failure
items.trigger: Landlord shall fail to perform or observe any of Landlord’s Lease Undertakings

items.description: Tenant must reimburse Landlord's actual attorneys' fees for reviewing a proposed Transfer or collecting Rent, to the extent they exceed the stated threshold.
items.span_text: Tenant agrees to pay to Landlord its actual attorneys’ fees whether suit be brought or not to the extent such fees exceed $500.00.
items.trigger: if it should otherwise be necessary or proper for Landlord to consult an attorney concerning this Lease for the review of instruments evidencing a proposed Transfer or for the purpose of collecting Rent

items.description: In any proceeding over enforcement, construction or interpretation of the Lease, the losing party must pay the winning party's attorneys' fees and costs.
items.span_text: then the non-prevailing party shall pay the prevailing party’s attorneys’ fees and costs
items.trigger: If either Landlord or Tenant initiates any litigation, mediation, arbitration or other proceeding regarding the enforcement, construction or interpretation of this Lease

items.description: Upon conveying its interest in the Property, Landlord must transfer any security given by Tenant to its successor in interest.
items.span_text: If any security has been given by Tenant to secure the faithful performance of any of the covenants of this Lease, Landlord shall transfer or deliver said security, as such, to Landlord’s successor in interest
items.trigger: Once and if Landlord (and/or any successor to Landlord) shall convey its interest in the Property to a third party
